purpose: Measure an output-qualified one-B70 HTTP aggregate-decode curve using deliberately small per-slot contexts.

identity.gpu: one Intel Arc Pro B70 32 GiB
identity.topology: TP1 / one visible Level Zero device

measurement_contract.aggregate_metric: sum(completion_tokens) / synchronized HTTP batch wall time
measurement_contract.semantic_quality: separate from this deterministic output-identity gate

classification.qualified: Every request returns 128 tokens, cached_tokens=0, and exactly matches its sequential same-server oracle.
classification.measured_output_variant: The service completes and timing is retained, but one or more output/cache/completeness gates fail.
classification.unsupported: The exact 64-slot profile cannot load or complete on one B70; retain the failure and do not fabricate a curve.
